rationale: Strength moved when “may signal that disagreement is socially acceptable” became unhedged “signaling,” and the present-study association (“was associated with”) became “predicted.” The revision also changed “lower return engagement” into the stronger binary claim “whether users returned at all.” Citation attachment was merged: “(Sato, 2019; Dlamini & Kroll, 2021)” follows both credibility propositions, and “(Petrescu, 2022; Al-Masri & Ko, 2023)” follows both interaction-norm propositions, obscuring each citation’s required distinct attachment. Other unauthorized content shifts include “can increase selective exposure” becoming “can narrow the range of viewpoints” and “can increase willingness” becoming “can shape willingness.”
